platform: macOS 27.2.1 ARM64, Apple clang 21.0.0, CMake 4.4.5, Release static library
finding: Two CMake installs of the same built archive differed in the archive index timestamp. CMake invokes ranlib without deterministic mode after copying a static archive on this host; the two installed archives otherwise differed only in timestamp bytes.
change: For macOS static-library installs, run the configured ranlib with -D after the standard install step. Resolve relative or absolute libdir, install-time --prefix and DESTDIR, and fail installation if deterministic indexing fails. Shared-library installations do not use this hook.
validation: The new opt-in check_macos_repeat_static_install control fails against the previous generated install script, then passes after reconfiguration. It waits across an index timestamp boundary, installs to a prefix containing spaces and separately through DESTDIR, compares archive SHA-256 values, and compiles and runs a consumer against each archive.
A staged package check including relocated-prefix consumer routes passes on this host; the source and relocated original archive hashes matched before the deterministic-index change.
An injected ranlib wrapper that fails only on -D produces a fatal install error. Configure-only controls verify shared builds omit the hook and absolute libdir retains install-time DESTDIR handling.
limits: This proves repeated installs of the same local built archive, not bit-for-bit reproducibility across clean builds, toolchains or platforms. ABI, distribution, and native platform qualification remain open; no format support claim is promoted.
